brief:
Israel ordered the British consulate in East Jerusalem to close by Thursday, citing London's stated plans to impose sanctions on settlements. Workers removed signs and plaques from the building overnight as the deadline expired, according to Reuters reporting.

The closure marked an escalation in tensions between Israel and Britain over policy toward Palestinian territories. The order came after Britain signaled its intention to sanction Israeli settlements, prompting the shutdown demand from Israeli authorities.

title: Britain removes East Jerusalem consulate signage after Israeli shutdown order
